test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which part of India does the Great Indian Desert lie?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Western part.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The **Great Indian Desert**, also known as the **Thar Desert** lies in the **western part** of India. 
 
• About **85%** of the desert lies in the **Indian territory** and the remaining** 15% is in Pakistan. **
 
• The **desert in Pakistan** is known by the name** Rohi or Cholistan **desert. 
 
• About **60% **of the desert in India lies in **Rajasthan** and the remaining extends into **Gujarat, Punjab, and Haryana. **
